answers.reason: As the representative of the faculty towards the university leadership, the dean takes part in the central senate.
The budget planning round allocates funds to faculties, and the dean represents the faculty towards the university leadership.
The dean leads the faculty and holds a higher office than the faculty-level appointment committee.
The description explicitly states that the dean chairs the faculty council.
The study commission advises the faculty council, and the dean may take part in all bodies at or below the faculty level.
As head of the faculty, the dean holds a higher office and may take part in the bodies below their level.
This round awards the faculty's internal grants, placing it within the faculty where the dean holds the highest office.
Holders of a higher office like the dean are permitted to take part in any working group below their level in the faculty.
The dean leads the faculty and is permitted to take part in all subordinate decision occasions within the faculty.
Because those with a higher office may take part in bodies below their level, the dean is permitted to join this faculty-level planning round.
